subject.title: feat(gateway): add configurable Control UI title

question: Should OpenClaw accept a static `gateway.controlUi.title` config key, and should that configured title override dynamic session- or agent-derived browser titles when both exist?
rationale: This PR adds a new strict operator config surface and overlaps with open dynamic browser-title work, so the permanent UX/config precedence needs maintainer intent before repair or merge.

options.title: Sponsor Static Title Config
options.body: Accept the static config surface, require docs plus a rebase onto the current UI config loader, and make the configured title the explicit override for dynamic title work.

options.title: Prefer Dynamic Titles
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep browser-title policy on active session or agent title behavior instead.

options.title: Accept As Operator Escape Hatch
options.body: Allow the strict config key despite rollback friction, but document that operators must remove it before downgrading.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Static Title Config
recommendation.body: Accept the static config surface, require docs plus a rebase onto the current UI config loader, and make the configured title the explicit override for dynamic title work.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent owner signal for the current bootstrap/UI/docs surfaces and was also pulled into the related static-title discussion.
